title: Eridu found in the 1800s, its ziggurat never excavated

tellings.quote: so in the 1800s they find aido and they only excavate the main part of the city they find tablets and everything they bring them to the British museum they never excavate the arido zigon

plain: Eridu, an ancient city in southern Iraq, was found in the 1800s, but diggers only excavated the main part of the city. They found clay tablets and other finds and sent them to the British Museum, yet never dug into its ziggurat, the city's great stepped temple tower. Matt LaCroix, a researcher of ancient civilizations, tells Michels this, drawing on the Wikipedia entry for Eridu, and his point is that whatever lies under the ziggurat has never been looked at.
